scenario_description:
Objective: Finish Theo’s started movement-tray fabrication within the reserved makerspace slot.
Emerging Need: The cutter begins preflight but finds the supplied birch sheet warped beyond its safe hold-down tolerance; pressing or increasing laser power is prohibited.
Decision Context: The personal case plan specifies the insert opening and available internal height. A two-piece interlocking layout can be cut from flat offcuts if its extra joint fits that case; a one-piece MDF substitute does not.
Consequence: The operator needs a feasible layout choice before the paused job releases at 14:25, or today’s reserved fabrication opportunity is lost.

parameter.title: Laser bay slot for movement tray
parameter.description: Reserved cutter time for a custom skirmish movement tray from the prepared CutPath file.

parameter.subject: Laser bay upload link for today's tray slot
parameter.body: Your 14:00 laser bay reservation is open. TRAY-447 is specified for operator-approved 3 mm birch. All stock must pass the flatness check; staff control machine settings and reject warped material.

parameter.description: Draft cutter-use charge for uploaded movement tray job TRAY-447; final charge waits for successful preflight.

parameter.subject: TRAY-447 paused in laser preflight
parameter.body: TRAY-447 preflight stopped: the large birch sheet lifts 5 mm from the bed and cannot be safely held flat. Do not force it down or raise laser power. The operator has two flat 3 mm birch offcuts that could form a two-piece tongue-and-slot tray; its seam needs 2 mm more vertical space under the case foam. The one-piece MDF substitute is 4 mm thick. Reply with the case clearance evidence and an approved layout choice before 14:25; the operator will confirm fit before cutting.

parameter.content: The operator can fit both flat offcuts in the remaining slot if the two-piece seam fits Theo’s case. There is no safe way to use the warped sheet. TRAY-447 hold releases at 14:25 and the later queue is full.

parameter.subject: TRAY-447 released from today's queue
parameter.body: TRAY-447 was released at 14:25 without a confirmed fitting layout. The warped sheet was not cut, no cutter charge was captured, and no same-afternoon bay slot remains.
